name: M-Pesa (Safaricom Daraja)

status.webhook_verification: No signature. Daraja POSTs Body.stkCallback to the CallBackURL supplied in the STK Push. Trust is established by (a) ManishaPay OWNING the callback URL (public HTTPS, never merchant-supplied) and (b) correlating on CheckoutRequestID; must ack HTTP 200 within ~30s. Poll STK Query as a fallback only.

credentials_required.label: Consumer Key
credentials_required.note: Daraja portal → your app → Keys. Used with the secret for OAuth Basic auth.

credentials_required.label: Business Shortcode
credentials_required.note: Paybill or Till (Buy Goods) number. Sandbox shortcode is 174379.

credentials_required.label: Lipa na M-Pesa Passkey
credentials_required.note: Daraja → Lipa na M-Pesa Online → Passkey. Concatenated with shortcode+timestamp and base64-encoded to form the STK Password.

credentials_required.label: Transaction Type
credentials_required.note: CustomerPayBillOnline (Paybill, default) or CustomerBuyGoodsTill (Till). CallBackURL is NOT collected — ManishaPay owns it.

test_credentials.note: Consumer Key/Secret are generated instantly per app in the Daraja portal (no KYC). Sandbox auto-approves the prompt (no PIN).

sandbox.notes: Canonical password vector: base64('174379' + passkey + '20160216165627') = MTc0Mzc5YmZiMjc5ZjlhYTliZGJjZjE1OGU5N2RkNzFhNDY3Y2QyZTBjODkzMDU5YjEwZjc4ZTZiNzJhZGExZWQyYzkxOTIwMTYwMjE2MTY1NjI3. Sandbox STK Query is unreliable — drive failure paths by replaying callback payloads with ResultCode 1032/1037/1. Live requires Go-Live approval (days) which issues a production shortcode + passkey.

pain_points.problem: OAuth access token expires and calls 401 mid-flow
pain_points.cause: Daraja tokens live ~3600s; a stale cached token or none at all
pain_points.mitigation: Cache the token per (mode, consumerKey), refresh at ~50min, and retry the request exactly once on a 401 after forcing a fresh token

pain_points.cause: CallBackURL is http://, localhost, or a self-signed host — Daraja drops these silently
pain_points.mitigation: ManishaPay OWNS a single hardened public HTTPS callback; the merchant never supplies one. Correlate on CheckoutRequestID and fan out to the merchant webhook — structurally eliminates the #1 failure

pain_points.cause: Timestamp used in Password differs from the Timestamp field, or the passkey has a trailing newline
pain_points.mitigation: Generate the YYYYMMDDHHMMSS timestamp ONCE, build Password=base64(shortcode+passkey+timestamp) with the SAME value in the same call, trim the passkey; unit-test against the canonical vector

pain_points.cause: Passing decimals — M-Pesa amounts are whole KES only
pain_points.mitigation: Coerce to an integer at the edge and refuse fractional values loudly rather than silently rounding

pain_points.problem: STK prompt never reaches the phone

pain_points.cause: User ignored/cancelled the prompt (1037/1032) and the callback was missed; sandbox STK Query is unreliable
pain_points.mitigation: Bounded ~90-120s timer with an STK Query fallback and a hard deadline that resolves to failed with the ResultCode reason

pain_points.cause: Daraja can deliver/replay the callback more than once; must 200 within ~30s or it retries
pain_points.mitigation: Ack 200 immediately, process async, dedupe on MpesaReceiptNumber

pain_points.cause: Mixing sandbox.safaricom.co.ke host / shortcode 174379 with production keys (or vice-versa)
pain_points.mitigation: Make environment first-class config; pick host + shortcode + passkey atomically per mode

notes: Daraja is KENYA ONLY (KES). Tanzania/Mozambique/DRC/Ghana M-Pesa run on a SEPARATE platform (Vodacom OpenAPI) with different auth — do not reuse this integration. STK Push (M-Pesa Express) is a mobilePush flow: no redirect/checkout URL, the customer approves a prompt on their phone. The synchronous ResponseCode 0 means 'prompt sent', NOT paid — the real result is the async callback's ResultCode. Refund exists only as the Reversal API (POST /mpesa/reversal/v1/request), which needs an Initiator + RSA-encrypted SecurityCredential (extra Go-Live step) and is not wired here. Recurring is not native — schedule a fresh STK each cycle (the customer approves every time).

verification.verified_notes: STK push verified live against the Daraja sandbox (real CheckoutRequestID; ResponseCode 0). Password = base64(shortcode+passkey+timestamp) with the SAME timestamp; sandbox uses public test shortcode 174379 + passkey with any sandbox app's consumer key/secret.
unverified_fields: async callback receipt (needs a public webhook)
